profile.description: Localhost seccomp profile path. Required when the profile type is `Localhost`.

type.description: Seccomp profile type used by the container.

seccompProfile.description: Define the seccompProfile for the container.

runAsUser.description: Define the runAsUser for the container

runAsGroup.description: Define the runAsGroup for the container

fsGroup.description: Legacy container-level `fsGroup`, set by `stable/chevereto` and `stable/n8n` as `securityContext.container.fsGroup`. The container security context template does not read it, and `fsGroup` is a pod-level field in Kubernetes. Set `fsGroup` under `securityContext.pod` instead.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Define the readOnlyRootFilesystem for the container

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Define the allowPrivilegeEscalation for the container

privileged.description: Define the privileged for the container

runAsNonRoot.description: Define the runAsNonRoot for the container

add.description: Define the capabilities.add for the container

drop.description: Define the capabilities.drop for the container

disableS6Caps.description: Disable automatic S6 capabilities when the container runs as root.

capabilities.description: Define the capabilities for the container If at least one capability is defined in either [`add`](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/securityContext#securitycontextcapabilitiesadd) or [`drop`](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/securityContext#securitycontextcapabilitiesdrop)

PUID.description: Default user ID used for container environment variables.

UMASK.description: Default file creation mask used for container environment variables.
